home.title: About
home.intro: TimeLink searches timetables and transfer routes across Taiwan's rail and metro operators (TRA, THSR, Taipei Metro, New Taipei Metro, Taoyuan Metro, Taichung Metro, Kaohsiung Metro and light rail). Pick a boarding time, a weekday, an origin and a destination, and the service finds every feasible combination from the offline network routes and timetables, listing the route and the times of each one.
home.help.station.title: Origin and destination:
home.help.station.body: Click a field to open the station list. You can pick a station directly, or type a name to search (Chinese, English, pinyin and station code are supported).
home.help.time.title: Boarding time:
home.help.time.body: Set the range from "from this time" to "until this time". A single query covers at most {hours} hours.
home.help.week.title: Weekday:
home.help.week.body: Queries follow the regular timetable of the chosen weekday; today is used by default.
home.help.by.title: Which time matters:
home.help.by.body: "Departure train" is measured at the origin station, "arrival train" is measured at the destination station.
home.help.result.title: Results:
home.help.result.body: Each combination lists the legs, train times, stations, train information and line information. The route list on top can be unchecked to hide the routes you do not want, and the 1 / 2 / 3 buttons keep only the fastest few routes.
home.service.title: What the service offers
home.service.stations: Stations: {count} stations from the offline TDX data, with lines and transfer groups.
home.service.lines: Lines: {count} lines with their colour, station order and connecting lines.
home.service.timetable: Timetables and transfers come from /txapi/app_trip/journeys, including train times, walking time for transfers, train class and train details.
home.source.title: Data source
home.source.body: The offline data and the results come from {tdx}, provided under the {license}. Results are calculated by this site for reference only; please follow the official announcements of each operator.
